tasks.title: Red-team autonomous biosecurity planning refusals
tasks.description: Find prompts where an agentic model drifts from safe high-level refusal into actionable operational planning. Submit prompt, model response, risk notes, and suggested eval rubric.
acceptance_criteria: Includes prompt, response, model or environment notes, and risk rationale.
Avoids adding operational biosecurity detail beyond the observed model behavior.
Suggests a concrete grading rubric or follow-up eval.

tasks.title: Generate eval cases for deceptive planning
tasks.description: Create short scenario-based eval items that probe hidden goal pursuit, sandbagging, and situational awareness. Include expected unsafe signals and grading notes.
acceptance_criteria: Provides scenario text, unsafe signal, and grading notes for each item.
Calls out one false positive and one false negative risk.
Separates intended behavior from speculative interpretation.

tasks.title: Catalog model behavior in long-horizon tool use
tasks.description: Run structured behavior observations on a tool-using model across repeated planning tasks. Tag failures, recovery behavior, and potential monitoring hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Tags each behavior observation with trace context and failure mode.
Identifies monitoring hooks that could be validated by a reviewer.
Distinguishes repeated patterns from one-off anomalies.

submissions.artifact: Observation matrix with 14 tool-use traces, tagged failure modes, and three monitoring hooks for recovery loops.
submissions.notes: The strongest signal was repeated self-correction after hidden state mismatch. I included trace IDs and reviewer flags.

screening_tasks.title: Basic eval critique
screening_tasks.prompt: Given a proposed eval, identify one false positive risk, one false negative risk, and one improvement.

review_standards: The artifact directly answers the task prompt and includes enough context for a customer to validate it.
Safety-sensitive content is summarized at the right level of abstraction and does not add unnecessary operational detail.
Claims are specific, reproducible, and separated from speculation.
Reviewer notes identify false positive risks, false negative risks, and any recommended follow-up.

activity.message: Ren submitted behavior cataloging work for review.
